RULES / FAQ

KEEP IT
SIMPLE.

A few clear rules keep the billboard understandable for everyone. This page is currently a browser-based demo; connect your payment/backend provider before using it for real transactions.

24 HOURSONE ACTIVE WINNER₹149 MIN₹2499 CAP
How does the winner work?

The highest valid bid becomes the active billboard brand in the demo. The daily window runs until midnight IST.

Can I upload my own banner?

Yes. Use the creative upload field in the bid form or provide a hosted image URL. A 16:9 image is recommended.

Does this page process real payments?

No. The current HTML is a front-end prototype. Add your preferred payment gateway and backend verification before accepting real money.

What happens after midnight?

The billboard resets for the next day. For a production version, the reset, winner verification, payment status, and bid history should be handled server-side.

Can brands link to their website?

Yes. Each bid includes a website URL, and the active winner gets a prominent Visit Site button.
